purpose: Review one finite six-route local-data catalog after Campaign260 and select at most one genuinely independent three-session mechanism before reading any Campaign261 source row or scientific value.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_lorenz_gini_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Sort the exact 240 continuous-session amount masses and compute the finite-sample-normalized Lorenz-Gini inequality score.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: It is a parameter-free global inequality functional that deliberately discards the clock order. It is not determined by timing center, dispersion, temporal skew, weak-order states, local peaks or fixed-window shares, while numerical redundancy with participation entropy remains testable by the frozen all-comparator gate.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_herfindahl_concentration_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Choosing a power exponent would begin a concentration-index family sweep; the normalized Lorenz-Gini route is selected once without an exponent.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_theil_inequality_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Average amount-share log deviations from equality.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Theil is an entropy-family transform and is too close semantically to the existing participation entropy definition.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_coefficient_of_variation_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Divide the cross-minute amount standard deviation by its mean.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: It is a magnitude-distribution second-moment sibling and adds an avoidable denominator policy after the completed amount-clock dispersion route.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_lorenz_tail_or_half_session_variants
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Apply the selected inequality functional to a half-session, tail, or amount quantile subset.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Subwindow and tail variants would be rescue routes rather than independent mechanisms.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: amount_inequality_factor_combination_or_model
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Combine Gini with entropy, timing moments, peak, return or terminal factors.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign261 is one complete definition with no fit or combination; old terminal definitions remain unchanged.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_amount_lorenz_gini_240m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A session whose trading amount is concentrated in a small number of minutes reflects discrete unresolved attention or information arrival that may persist over the next three accepted sessions.
selected_candidate.formula_summary: For ascending amounts b_(i), n=240 and S=sum b_i, score=sum_i((2i-n-1)b_(i))/((n-1)S).
